# Qt resource bundle: the icons, theme glyphs and style sheets are compiled by
# rcc and linked into the executable, so the application runs from a single
# binary without installing asset files.
# Qt 资源包：图标、主题字形与样式表由 rcc 编译并链接进可执行文件，
# 因此程序以单个二进制运行，无需额外安装资源文件。
#
# The manifests are generated by tools/update_qrc.py.
# 资源清单由 tools/update_qrc.py 生成。
target_sources(QArchiver PRIVATE
    icons.qrc
    themes-aero.qrc
    themes-modern.qrc
)

# target_sources() does not enable AUTORCC by itself, so set it on the target.
# target_sources() 不会自动启用 AUTORCC，因此在目标上显式开启。
set_target_properties(QArchiver PROPERTIES AUTORCC ON)
